concerns.text: Task T013 (Data hygiene) is placed after T012 (GitHub Actions workflow) and after downstream tasks that rely on checksum metadata (e.g., T011 contract validation). Data‑hygiene must run before any contract‑validation or CI steps to ensure checksums are recorded prior to validation.
Task T014 (Pinned seeds) appears after many stochastic tasks (T002, T003, T004, T005, T009). The seed definition must be established before any stochastic component runs to guarantee reproducibility.

Task T011 (Run contract tests) is scheduled before T013 (Data hygiene) and T014 (Reproducibility seeds). Since contract validation expects artifacts to be checksum‑verified and reproducible, the ordering should be: T014 → T013 → T011 (or include T013/T014 earlier in the pipeline).
